messages:
sasha: Heads up — started canary cutover for release v1.42 (wave 4). Noting p99 spike on runtime-slice-A for text-gen, p50 OK. Anyone seeing this?

oncall-bot: INCIDENT_TRIGGERED: latency_threshold_exceeded on runtime-slice-A. Paging oncall (P1)

jess: I'm on it, grabbing traces and logs. which rollout id is this?

sasha: deploy-bot: rollout_id=7221 wave=4 image=mosaic-7b kernel=selector_v2

jess: quick scan: many nodes returned `kernel_selector: no-match -> fallback=kernel_generic`. Batch sizes slid down to 1 — throughput collapsed.

omar: repro locally shows 3-4x p99. curl example: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -d '{"model":"mosaic-7b","input":"hello"}'``` latency ~900-1200ms (expected 120-200ms)

mike: that selector flag is the new canary config. Can we flip the flag kill-switch?

sasha: recommended: flip feature flag and shift canary traffic to last-stable model variant, then reassess.

jess: executing kill-switch: `rdwctl flags set engine.kernel.selector=false --context rollout/7221` -> initiating now.

deploy-bot: FLAG_EVENT: engine.kernel.selector set to false by jess (runbook 7.3).

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: pager cleared, incident marked mitigated. Please follow up with postmortem.

omar: metrics: p99 returned to baseline within ~90s of flag flip. batching window re-expanded, KV cache hit-rate back to normal.

customer-success: flagged tenants that saw errors: tenant-acme, tenant-helix. CS drafting customer note now. No broader customer outages reported.

sasha: ops decision: no full rollback; keep selector disabled and pause wave. We'll re-run canary after kernel-selector index sync fix. Opening postmortem ticket.

jess: root cause notes for postmortem: during rolling kernel index refresh some nodes served with stale selector tables, causing selector_v2 to fallback to generic kernel and shrink batching. Action items: add preflight kernel-table check to rollout, add alert on batch-size-collapse, harden selector metadata sync in runtime.
